name: Modulo Global Sum
description: Replaces the algebraic polynomial with a reciprocal modulo sum: (c_u % c_v) + (c_v % c_u). This evaluates to exactly 1 if the grades differ (since 1%2 + 2%1 = 1) and 0 if they are identical (since x%x = 0). By requiring the global sum across m dampeners to be exactly m, it mathematically forces proper 2-coloring without using recognizable graph terminology or standard algebraic forms.
